# Twisted Pin

> Plainfield's premier night out. Bowling optional. Cocktails curated by Brian Van Flandern, America's Top Mixologist (Food Network), a 28-tap self-serve beer and wine wall, from-scratch food, 17 traditional lanes and one 6-lane VIP suite. Adults-first and family-welcome.

Twisted Pin is at 15610 Joliet Rd, Plainfield, IL 60544. Visit for drinks, food, bowling and games. See the FAQ for practical venue policies.

## Explore

- [Bar](https://www.twistedpin.com/bar/): Cocktail program and self-serve beer and wine wall.
- [Food](https://www.twistedpin.com/eat/): From-scratch food built to share.
- [Bowling](https://www.twistedpin.com/bowl/): 17 traditional lanes plus a 6-lane VIP suite.
- [VIP suite](https://www.twistedpin.com/vip-suite/): Six semi-private lanes set apart from the traditional lanes, reserved in pairs of 2, 4 or 6. When a group books all six, the whole suite is theirs during their event time. Up to 80 guests, subject to event arrangements.
- [Arcade](https://www.twistedpin.com/game/): Games and redemption prizes.
- [Events](https://www.twistedpin.com/events/): Current group-event options and planning.
